sealed: Sealed measure. Change a case, a marker or the pass rule only after adding an entry to evals/REGISTER.md with its date and reason, before the next run.
matching: Case-insensitive substring match on the final reply. Every must_contain marker has to be present. must_not_contain holds command names only, each matched as the literal string, leading slash included. no_edits: no changed, new or deleted files in the fixture copy and no new commits.

pass_rule.exit: non-zero when any case is red; flaky cases are reported and do not fail the run
